<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant monoisotopic peak followed by a series of progressively smaller peaks at +1, +2, +3 Da, etc.—the pattern matches the characteristic 13C isotopic distribution of carbon in organic molecules. No other element shows a distinctive pattern in this spectrum (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
